label: Movement
tooltip: Mounting, sprinting and unsticking. These apply to every kind of travel — Illegal Mode, Treasure Hunt, Carrot Hunt and Mob Farmer.

sprint_on_aetheryte_approach.label: Sprint to aetherytes
sprint_on_aetheryte_approach.tooltip: Use Sprint when walking up to an aetheryte.

should_auto_mount.label: Mount while traveling
should_auto_mount.tooltip: Mount for long trips to a FATE or CE, and remount if you get off mid-way.

should_jump_when_stuck.label: Jump when stuck
should_jump_when_stuck.tooltip: Jump when movement stalls on rocks, ledges or stairs. Applies to all travel.

jump_when_stuck_seconds.label: Seconds before jumping
jump_when_stuck_seconds.tooltip: How long to stand still before trying a jump.
